item.guhs.koh_spawn_egg: Koh the Face Stealer Spawn Egg
Welcome, little guh. What an... interesting little face you have. Do stay very, very calm.
I already have a thousand faces, nyeg. One more would look so... chonky on me.
*sniffs your hand* ...Do you smell a little like Nibble Chorus? My forest has smelled of ash for so long.
Shhh. Do you hear the forest whisper? It's whispering your name. ...No, just kidding. It's whispering 'nibble'.
Grrrum. Roku Guh and I flew above the clouds every morning. Mostly I miss the breakfast afterwards.
A spirit dragon flies wherever his heart wants to go. My heart mostly wants to go to the tea pavilion, nyeg.
We have swum in circles for ages. Push and pull, light and dark, Tui and La. Dizzy? Never.
No tides without the moon, no moon without the ocean. ...And no guhs without nibbles.
Bzzzz-hop! *looks at you VERY curiously* ...Bzzzz-HOP!
*sniffs your nose and zooms off* ...*comes back* ...*zooms off again*
I'm a little lost. But as long as I'm lit, I'm never completely in the dark, nyeg!
*winks* A lantern that winks? In the Spirit World that's perfectly normal, you know.
Shhh... go away. This is my dark little edge. I only push a little. *push*
I was once a thought nobody wanted to think. Now I push guhs aside. Nice career, nyeg.
I came here once for a single cup of tea. That was three hundred years ago. The tea is still delightful.
I know someone who will want to live here one day... round, a beard, says wise things about tea. I'm keeping a cushion free for him.
One order? Coming right up! *runs to the bank* ...Want a receipt with that, nyeg?
Just tell me what you need: I'll fetch it all from your bank and set the machines running. Fast, cheerful and chonky!
*puts a scroll down in front of you and taps it with its paw* ...Not reading? Then just follow me, nyeg!
Knowledge is never lost, says the owl. Only a little astray sometimes. That's what we're here for.
*looks at you with one eye* ...Kraa?
*shakes the mist off its feathers and stands on one leg*
I slept for ages around the stone lotus. Whoever lays all the tiles wakes me. That's you, then, nyeg.
The order began with one conversation over a game board. Everything that grows big starts very small.
You look like someone I was, a very long time ago.
*a sigh as deep as the mist itself*
*the distance rumbles softly, as if something very big is smiling*
*the mask slowly turns towards you*
*the mask looks. It keeps looking. You look back. It wins.*
Fire is not a toy, young guh. It eats everything you give it... your nibbles too.
Once I ran away from my own flame. Here in the mist I'm finally getting to know it, nyeg.
Is it really you, or am I dreaming about tea again? ...It doesn't matter. Sit down, nyeg.
Somewhere far away I'm simply drinking tea. This here is only a dream of mine. A cozy dream.
Hahaha! You still think in straight lines! Turn yourself around. Or turn the room around!
A mad old king knows: the answer that's right in front of you is usually the wrong one, nyeg.
No. ...Just kidding. I've learned you don't need a mustache to bend water.
Water forgets nothing. Not even the necklace I once carved, for someone I never forgot.
A sword is not a weapon but a brush. You paint your own story with it.
Breathe to the beat, parry to the beat. Rhythm is the quietest kind of courage, nyeg.
In Roku Guh's time we laid the first tile. One white lotus, in between all the flags.
The order belongs to no single nation. We belong to everyone who shares tea, wisdom and nibbles.
The password? ...A lotus blooms in the mud too. Welcome, nyeg.
I used to play Pai Sho every evening. I still do, just a little more see-through.
Ah, there you are! I was waiting for you. I like waiting. A sip of onion-banana juice? Very good for your chakras.
Let go of what weighs you down, young guh. Except your nibbles. You may keep those.
I once fought a spirit that stole faces. Hold on tight to yours, nyeg.
I used to think I had all the time in the world. Use yours well, Guhvatar.
Even an Air Nomad must stand firm sometimes, for those who love her.
The wind never blows for itself. It always carries something along: a leaf, a song, a whiff of nibbles.
You don't lead a nation with fire, but with good paperwork and a warm heart. Mostly the paperwork, nyeg.
I filled in forms my whole life. Even as a spirit I still carry a few.
*does a happy loop around your head* Bzzz-hop! I'm staying right here with you, nyeg.
*lands on your shoulder for a moment, sniffs your ear and zooms up again*
*settles on a leaf* I'll wait here. Bzzz... (sneak-click to take me along again)
*darts towards you* Bzzz-HOP! Along, along, along!
gui.guhs.einde2_geestmodellen.fang.vast: Fang is holding you tight. Hang on just a little longer, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.koh: Rarity: One, deep in his cave (and he'd rather you didn't come)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.koh: A gigantic centipede spirit who collects faces: hundreds of them, guhs' and Mikas' too. Whoever visits him shows nothing on their face: no laugh, no fright, no nyeg. He never really steals, but he does look very hungry.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.hei_bai_guh: Rarity: One, in the Whispering Wood
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.hei_bai_guh: A cute forest-spirit panda with a guh snout. When his forest is sad, he becomes a black giant with six arms and a white mask. A Nibble Chorus acorn from the Guh End calms him down: then he's small and cuddly again.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.fang: Rarity: One, on the Sky Path
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.fang: The spirit dragon of Guhvatar Roku Guh: red, see-through, with guh ears and long whiskers. He carries a Guhvatar on his neck where needed. Breakfast after a flight is the most important thing in the world to him.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.geest_koi: Rarity: Two, above the Sky Pond
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.geest_koi: Tui and La: the Moon Spirit and the Ocean Spirit, two gigantic glowing koi forever chasing each other. Push and pull, light and dark. Without them no tides, and without tides no beach to chonk out on.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.libelkonijnguh: A tiny bunny with a guh face and four dragonfly wings. Terribly curious: it follows you, sniffs your nose and zooms off as soon as you get too close. Whoever brings the lost lanterns home gets one that stays.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.lantaarngeest: Floating paper lanterns with a painted little face, in red, amber, pink and blue. They wink. They love getting lost, and love it even more when you bring them back to the lantern tree.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.schaduwgeest: Rarity: In the dark edges of the wood
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.schaduwgeest: Tall smoky shadows with two white eyes. They gently push you away from their dark little spot, nothing more. They can grumble with the best of them.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kennisvosje: Rarity: A few, at the White Lotus (and very rarely a golden one)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kennisvosje: Spirit foxes with round guh ears, family of Wan Shi Guh's foxes. They lug scrolls around. Follow one and it shows you a little secret. Seeing a golden knowledge fox is a story for your grandguhs.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.mistreiger: Rarity: On the roofs of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mistreiger: Small white herons with tiny ears. They stand on one leg in the mist and fly up as soon as you get too close. Sneaking closer helps a little.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.oude_reigerguh: Rarity: One, coiled around the stone lotus
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.oude_reigerguh: A gigantic see-through crane spirit with guh ears and a red crown. He slept for ages around the stone lotus, until someone laid all the Pai Sho tiles. He knows the whole history of the White Lotus, from the very first tile.
